import argparse
import qlib
from qlib.workflow import R
from qlib.workflow.online.manager import OnlineManager
from qlib.workflow.task.collect import collector_class_name
from qlib.workflow.task.normalize import normalize_class_name
from qlib.workflow.task.utils import _train_rolling_tasks, prepare_tasks, gen_following_tasks
from qlib.utils import class_casting
from qlib.workflow.task.utils import reset_parameters
from qlib.contrib.evaluate import risk_analysis, backtest
import os
import datetime

class RollingOnlineManager:
    def __init__(
        self,
        provider_uri,
        region,
        experiment_name,
        task_url,
        task_db_name,
        task_pool_name,
        rolling_step,
        start_time,
        end_time,
        tasks,
        trainer,
    ):
        self.provider_uri = provider_uri
        self.region = region
        self.experiment_name = experiment_name
        self.task_url = task_url
        self.task_db_name = task_db_name
        self.task_pool_name = task_pool_name
        self.rolling_step = rolling_step
        self.start_time = start_time
        self.end_time = end_time
        self.tasks = tasks
        self.trainer = trainer
        self.om = None

        qlib.init(provider_uri=self.provider_uri, region=self.region)
        self._init_manager()

    def _init_manager(self):
        self.om = OnlineManager(
            experiment_name=self.experiment_name,
            task_url=self.task_url,
            task_db_name=self.task_db_name,
            task_pool_name=self.task_pool_name,
            rolling_step=self.rolling_step,
            start_time=self.start_time,
            end_time=self.end_time,
            tasks=self.tasks,
            trainer=self.trainer,
        )

    def reset_experiment(self):
        if self.om is not None:
            self.om.reset_experiment()

    def run_workflow(self):
        self.reset_experiment()
        self.simulate()
        results = self.collect_results()
        signals = self.get_signals(results)
        bt_res = self.perform_backtesting(signals)
        risk = self.perform_risk_analysis(bt_res)
        return {
            "results": results,
            "signals": signals,
            "backtest": bt_res,
            "risk": risk,
        }

    def simulate(self):
        self.om.simulate()

    def collect_results(self):
        return self.om.collect_results()

    def get_signals(self, results):
        return self.om.get_signals(results)

    def perform_backtesting(self, signals):
        return backtest(signals)

    def perform_risk_analysis(self, bt_res):
        return risk_analysis(bt_res)

    def train_tasks_external(self, task_id):
        # For multiprocessing: train a specific task by task_id
        self.om.task_train(task_id)

    @staticmethod
    def from_args(args):
        return RollingOnlineManager(
            provider_uri=args.provider_uri,
            region=args.region,
            experiment_name=args.experiment_name,
            task_url=args.task_url,
            task_db_name=args.task_db_name,
            task_pool_name=args.task_pool_name,
            rolling_step=args.rolling_step,
            start_time=args.start_time,
            end_time=args.end_time,
            tasks=args.tasks,
            trainer=args.trainer,
        )

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Rolling OnlineManager Simulator")
    parser.add_argument("--provider_uri", type=str, required=True, help="Qlib data provider uri")
    parser.add_argument("--region", type=str, default="cn", help="Qlib region")
    parser.add_argument("--experiment_name", type=str, required=True, help="Experiment name")
    parser.add_argument("--task_url", type=str, required=True, help="Task URL")
    parser.add_argument("--task_db_name", type=str, required=True, help="Task DB name")
    parser.add_argument("--task_pool_name", type=str, required=True, help="Task pool name")
    parser.add_argument("--rolling_step", type=int, default=20, help="Rolling step")
    parser.add_argument("--start_time", type=str, required=True, help="Start time (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    parser.add_argument("--end_time", type=str, required=True, help="End time (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    parser.add_argument("--tasks", type=str, required=True, help="Tasks config file (python dict string)")
    parser.add_argument("--trainer", type=str, required=True, help="Trainer class name")
    parser.add_argument("--train_task_id", type=str, default=None, help="Train a specific task by id (for multiprocessing)")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    # Convert tasks string to dict
    import ast
    tasks = ast.literal_eval(args.tasks)
    args.tasks = tasks

    manager = RollingOnlineManager.from_args(args)

    if args.train_task_id:
        manager.train_tasks_external(args.train_task_id)
    else:
        results = manager.run_workflow()
        print("Workflow Results:")
        print(results)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
